title: Kneaded Light Moroccan Pistachio Chebakia
description: A delicate and flavorful Moroccan dessert featuring pistachio, with a floral and glassy-jelly texture, made with wholesome ingredients, kneaded to perfection, and Whole30-friendly.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine almond flour, pistachio meal, and coconut sugar, whisking until well combined.
Add orange blossom water, lemon juice, and melted ghee to the dry ingredients, stirring until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes, until smooth and pliable.
Divide the dough into 12 equal pieces, rolling each into a ball.
Use a cookie press or a pastry bag to shape the balls into chebakia shapes.
Place the shaped chebakia on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Brush the tops with beaten egg and sprinkle with salt.
Bake in a preheated oven at 350 degrees Fahrenheit for 20 minutes, or until lightly golden.
Remove from the oven and let cool completely on a wire rack.
Serve at room temperature, garnished with chopped pistachios if desired.
